fixes.explanation: Good deeds, you got it, baker! Paul says he wants this stressed “…so that those who have believed God will take care to devote themselves to good deeds.” Look who it's for: those who have believed God. Believing and doing good show up in the same sentence, and I'm not about to separate them. I tried that once with a batch. Chocolate chips on one side of the counter, dough on the other, and nobody wanted what came out of that oven.

problems.problem: The explanation still mainly restates the verse. The dough and chocolate chips comparison is mild and does not give it a distinctive Papa Dorin voice.
